response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience as a full-stack software and web developer, but completely lacks the highly specialized hardware, SoC modeling, and AI accelerator optimization experience required for this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Over 10 years of professional software development experience, meeting the baseline chronological requirement.
Proven ability to build and optimize low-latency software applications using DLang and asynchronous I/O.
Strong engineering fundamentals with expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship.
concerns: Completely lacks required experience in SoC and IP modeling or hardware-software co-design.
Zero demonstrated background in AI accelerators, deep learning workloads, or GPU architecture.
Career has focused almost entirely on web, full-stack, and mobile development rather than hardware performance.
